title: The same downhill road in summer, autumn and winter
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
I'm trying to make Fjordfall feel like a place you can come back to and find something different. Here's the same descent in summer, autumn and winter.

I've been building it with Claude Code and Codex, using TypeScript and three.js. For this comparison, the rider follows the same path in each season so I can see what changes along the road.

Still early, free in your browser: [https://fjordfall.fly.dev/?via=ragd](https://fjordfall.fly.dev/?via=ragd)

How much would you want the season to affect the ride itself? I keep going back and forth on how much realism belongs in a game that's meant to be relaxing.
